manifest.author: Shellex
manifest.description: A delicate status bar for time, runtime memory, CPU estimate and vault storage.

files.README.md:
# Succinea

Succinea is a small host status bar app for Shellex OS. It can show date/time, app count, memory, CPU estimate and vault storage.

Configuration lives at `/system/succinea/config.json` inside the vault.
files.config.example.json:
{
  "label": "Succinea",
  "showDateTime": true,
  "showMemory": true,
  "showCpu": true,
  "showStorage": true,
  "showRunningApps": true,
  "compact": true
}
